scope: Headless functional checks only. No run-all, world-core cost, rest cost, picture cost or G4. No push.
machine: Desktop CPU / NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti through WSL D3D12; phone viewport is not an iPhone measurement. Shared builders active.

runtimeValidation: All unit-8b final functional checks pass; existing regression timing results are listed below separately.
notes: Raw earlier failures are retained, including conservative proxy visual gaps and the first fitted shard energy spike. Final 100-seed contacts pass without a shared solver or threshold change.
Hop assertion observes the physical velocity/peak within 16 fixed steps instead of sampling after the short arc.
Pose fixture preloads and waits for the actual completed transition with the existing accelerated fixture; no production pose timing changed.

DPR is pinned for repeatable screenshot/idle comparisons. Earlier unpinned runs observed presentation refreshes without physics steps; adaptive-DPR layout invalidation is the suspected source, not an isolated proof.
The water fixture waits for physical shards to sleep before the unchanged 30-second zero-step rotor test.
The broad play attempt was interrupted with exit 143 after several timing misses; it is not an all-pass regression run.
Cloud src/eggs/bolt.js is byte-identical to the unit starting base. Frozen support signatures and world solver are unchanged.
